purpose: Licences a person read from a manufacturer's own package or page, for boards whose terms are not in a GitHub repository. read_licenses.py --statements applies one only when the source still has the reviewed SHA-256 and every quote is still in it. 'fields' and 'scope' limit a statement to the files it covers.

quotes: This project's hardware is licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License.
statements.covers: The CAD package linked from the UNO R3 documentation page: UNO-TH_Rev3e.brd and UNO-TH_Rev3e.sch. The separate content.arduino.cc/assets/UNO-TH_Rev3e.zip marks its files 'CC-SA-BY-NC' and is not used.
